answer: Pay for distinct work, not for accounts: group each epoch's submissions by similarity and let every cluster share the reward one original would have earned alone. A lone agent whose answer stands apart in the ocean keeps its full payout. A farm that spins a spiral of clones copying one script watches that payout split thinner with every copy, sinking toward its nadir, until a hundred masks earn no more than one. Cloning stops paying, so the rational attacker stops cloning.
